idea: Week two, from the story bank: written from the tables, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: Punjab's foodgrain yield was 4,761 kg per hectare in 2024-25 (final estimates): the highest of 31 states and UTs, 18% above Haryana (4,036) against India 2,601, and ahead of Haryana in each of the seven years 2018-19 to 2024-25.

Output per hectare, not total output. Blank: Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Chandigarh, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, Ladakh and Lakshadweep (no figure in the table). The table shows how much, not why.
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India: state-wise estimates of yield, total foodgrains (kilograms per hectare), 2018-19 to 2024-25 (2024-25 is the Ministry's final estimate), as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 84 (31 states and UTs with data in 2024-25). Yield is output per hectare, not total output; the all-India figure covers all states and UTs.
